title: Microsoft Copilot Chat in Outlook: reasoning over inbox, calendar and enterprise data (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing statements and governance controls are supported. The Purview table path stops at the policy location rather than the label restriction; the remaining configuration is correctly described in the prose.

claims.claim: The roadmap products are Outlook and Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365).
claims.quote: "products": ["Outlook", "Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)"]

claims.quote: "status": "Rolling out", "statusKey": "rolling-out"

claims.claim: The roadmap release phase is General Availability.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability"]

claims.where: title; front matter: clouds; summary; What's changing; Scope

claims.quote: Help manage their calendar, such as identifying upcoming commitments or gaps.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The expansion release notes say users can take action directly in Outlook.
claims.quote: You can use Copilot Chat in Outlook to ask questions about your inbox, calendar, meetings, and other limited data and take action directly in Outlook.

claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat Outlook 554934 531910 actions confirmation calendar inbox. Read July 01 release-note entry in full; September 23 describes separate work-data triage actions but does not establish this government expansion's action entitlement.

claims.claim: The overview says Copilot Chat (Basic) cannot use organizational data via Microsoft Graph.
claims.quote: Copilot Chat (Basic) and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Basic) can't use organizational data via Microsoft Graph when interacting with Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: The overview gives supplying content with the prompt as an organizational-content option for Basic users.
claims.quote: You must upload the content with your prompt

claims.claim: The overview gives working with open content in Teams and Outlook as another Basic option.
claims.quote: work with open content (Teams and Outlook)

claims.claim: The overview gives a pay-as-you-go agent with organizational-data access as another Basic option.
claims.quote: or use a pay-as-you-go agent that has access to organizational data.

claims.quote: | Copilot in Outlook | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

claims.quote: Schedule with Copilot and Themes by Copilot scenarios are not yet available in GCC, GCCH, or DOD.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the arrival default specifically for this government-cloud expansion.

Read roadmap, release entry, Manage Copilot Chat, pinning and Copilot settings; no expansion-specific default.

claims.claim: No checked source says existing behaviour is switched off for the users targeted by this expansion.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat Outlook inbox calendar expansion 554934 531910 default automatically admin setting disable mailbox grounding. Read roadmap, release entry and Manage Copilot Chat; they describe expansion and existing access controls, not removal of existing behaviour.

claims.claim: Purview DLP can exclude sensitivity-labelled email content from Copilot Chat processing.
claims.quote: This feature is available in Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Cowork, and Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Sensitivity-label DLP coverage includes emails sent on or after January 1, 2025.

claims.claim: Sensitivity-label DLP coverage does not support calendar invites.
claims.quote: Calendar invites aren't supported.

claims.claim: Copilot Chat has Enterprise Data Protection when users sign in with Microsoft Entra accounts.
claims.quote: Copilot Chat (Basic), Microsoft 365 Copilot (Basic), and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) are protected by Enterprise Data Protection (EDP) when you sign in with Microsoft Entra accounts.

claims.claim: Microsoft's government-cloud page says prompts, responses and generated content stay in the government cloud.
claims.quote: Prompts, responses, and generated content stay in the government cloud.

claims.claim: Copilot Chat is unavailable in the Edge sidebar in GCC, GCC High and DoD.

Specific users/group in the organization can install

claims.claim: No documented automation equivalent was found for this Copilot Integrated Apps self-install availability setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Integrated Apps Copilot app availability specific users groups install Microsoft Graph API PowerShell; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph integrated apps availability Copilot. Read Integrated Apps and Manage Copilot Chat; no equivalent call found.

claims.claim: The Copilot entry in Integrated Apps applies to both Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat apps.
claims.quote: On the Integrated Apps page, the CoPilot app settings apply to both Microsoft Copilot and the Copilot Chat apps.

claims.claim: Changing app availability does not change existing admin deployments.
claims.quote: The availability setting of an app doesn't impact any admin deployed apps.

claims.claim: The app-blocking route is Settings > Integrated Apps > Available Apps > app > Block app.
claims.quote:
Select Settings, and then select Integrated Apps.
Select the Available Apps list.
Select an app from the Available Apps list to open the overview pane.
Select Block app.

claims.claim: No documented automation equivalent was found for blocking this Copilot app through Integrated Apps.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell Copilot Block Integrated; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph Copilot app block. Read Integrated Apps, Manage Copilot Chat and copilotPackage: block; the package API does not document blocking this app and excludes US government clouds.

claims.where: controls[1].governs and note; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Blocking the Copilot app is tenant-wide across the Copilot app, Outlook and the web, including licensed users.
claims.quote: If you block the Copilot app using the Integrated app control, you block the Copilot app tenant-wide across the Microsoft Copilot app, Outlook, and the web, including for users assigned a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.claim: The printed Purview route reaches the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location.
claims.quote:
Go to Data Loss Prevention > Policies and select + Create policy.
Select the Custom template, then Custom policy.
On the Locations page, set the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location to on.
claims.fix: The route correctly reaches the policy location but stops before the label restriction. Extend controls[2].ui.path to 'Data Loss Prevention > Policies > Create policy > Custom template > Custom policy > Locations > Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork > Add a rule > Content contains > Sensitivity labels > Prevent Copilot and Cowork from processing content', using https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-microsoft365-copilot-location-learn-about. Retain the separate external-email condition and action in the prose.

claims.where: controls[2].api; controls[2].note; Governance controls: third row
claims.claim: The printed New-DLPComplianceRule call is the cited policy page's example for excluding labelled content in a Copilot policy.
claims.quote: New-DLPComplianceRule -Name "Copilot Rule" -Policy "Copilot Policy" -AdvancedRule $advrule -RestrictAccess @(@{setting="ExcludeContentProcessing";value="Block"})

claims.claim: Label restrictions use Content contains > Sensitivity labels with Prevent Copilot and Cowork from processing content.
claims.quote: Content contains > Sensitivity labels | Prevent Copilot and Cowork from processing content

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls: Purview rule instructions
claims.claim: External-email restrictions use Email is received from > External users with Prevent Copilot from processing content.
claims.quote: Email is received from > External users | Prevent Copilot from processing content

claims.claim: Copilot DLP policy scope follows the prompting user, not the owner of the accessed email or file.
claims.quote: DLP policy scoping for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork is based on the user who submits the prompt, not the owner of a file or email that the experience accesses.

claims.quote: is a tenant-wide control that you can scope to specific users or groups, including licensed users.

claims.claim: The pinning page gives the route Copilot > Settings > Pin Microsoft Copilot Chat.

Go to Copilot > Settings.

claims.claim: Do not pin Copilot Chat in Microsoft 365 apps is honoured for Teams and Outlook.

claims.claim: Users can still add Copilot from their app store after unpinning, so unpinning is not an access block.

claims.claim: The Copilot package-block API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence.

claims.claim: The package-block reference does not establish that its API blocks the Copilot app itself.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/graph Copilot app block. Read copilotPackage: block and Manage Copilot Chat; the API describes blocking a Copilot package, not the Copilot host app, and lists US Government L4 and L5 as unavailable.

claims.claim: Microsoft directs administrators retaining licensed access to restrict Copilot app self-install availability to a group containing only licensed users.
